Welcome to "Palms and Pines!" You and your family are sure to enjoy the porches galore found in this home! Situated in the perfect location, walkable to the shops and restaurants of both Alys and Rosemary Beach, this beautiful large family friendly beach home sits nestled in the heart of beautiful Seacrest Beach North! While staying at Palms and Pines you are only minutes from the resort style community pool, walking distance to both the shops and restaurants of the Seacrest Beach North Town Center, and only several hundred yards from the Gulf of Mexico, just on the North side of 30A. The community of Seacrest sits just between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach.



As you walk up to the home the first thing to catch your eye will be the large wrap around front porch with seating to enjoy the gorgeous weather! Walking in the front door, you are greeted by an open concept kitchen/family room with plenty of seating for everyone in the group to enjoy! There are 10 seats at the large kitchen table, 4 additional stools at the kitchen counter, the family room has seating galore, and a queen sized sleeper sofa should you need an extra sleeping arrangement! Also located on the first floor are 2 guest bedrooms one queen and one king, both with access to yet another porch off the back of the home which is completely screened in! The bedrooms on the first floor are accompanied by a full bathroom with tub/shower combo and a 1/2 bathroom for your convenience. These first floor bedrooms/baths, are perfect for the members in your party who don't love using the stairs!



As you make your way up to the second level of the home, you will find 2 additional bedrooms. The first room you will see is the bunk room, boasting space to sleep up to 6 kids! There are 2 sets of twin over full bunk beds in this room, as well as a private bathroom with a tub/shower combo. Also on this level you will find the expansive Master Suite! This lovely large Master Suite comes complete with a King bed, a large jacuzzi tub, walk-in shower, and, as if that wasn't enough...there is also access to a small private balcony! You will also find the home's laundry room on this level.



On the 3rd floor of the home you will find a 2nd living area! Complete with a wet bar, mini fridge, a twin daybed with a trundle and a flat screen TV! You will also find yet another outdoor living area on this level...a large covered patio with table and chairs, as well as a few loungers for soaking up those rays!!



One trip to this wonderful family beach home, and you will know you've found your annual family vacation destination for years to come!!



Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bike rental, back pack beach chairs, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!

- Front wrap around porch and 2nd floor balcony and 3rd floor covered patio

- Screened in back porch

- Complimentary WIFI & Cable TV Throughout!

- Stainless Steel Kitchen Appliances

- K cup or standard coffee pot

- Gas Grill

- Large dining table

- Laundry Room with Washer and Dryer

- Parking for MAX 2 Cars

- Access to 12,000 sq ft. Lagoon Pool

- FREE Shuttle Service to Beach and Pool (Seasonally)

- In walking distance to Village of South Walton

- Walking Distance to Rosemary and Alys Beach



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING: Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.







FAQ's

Type of coffee pot: Keurig and drip standard coffee pot

Parking spots: MAX 2 vehicles in driveway (Overflow street parking available in neighborhood on a first come first serve basis.)

Distance to beach: Drive: 5 minutes / Bike ride: 6 minutes

Beach Chairs & Umbrella set-up included: NO ( can use rental credit toward beach chair set-up at Public Beach access.)

Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
